projects.name: Chemistry Voice Tutor (B.Sc. Graduation Project)
highlights: Real-time voice AI agent targeting sub-200ms end-to-end latency on edge hardware, coordinating OpenAI Whisper (STT), Mistral LLM inference, and LiveKit WebRTC in a unified low-resource pipeline.
Context-aware RAG pipeline with vector embeddings and domain-specific prompt engineering to ground LLM responses in verified chemistry knowledge.

projects.name: Agentic RAG Research Assistant
highlights: Stateful LangGraph workflow with three retrieval modes — local FAISS RAG, live Tavily web search, hybrid — controlled by an LLM-powered Query Analyzer that classifies intent before retrieval.
Automatic inline citation generation and a dedicated Summarizer node, producing source-grounded answers ready to use without further cleanup.
Zero-code-change configurability between local Ollama and cloud OpenAI backends for cost-aware deployment switching.

projects.name: Multimodal Enterprise Knowledge System
highlights: Multi-modal RAG architecture ingesting and indexing PDFs, images, and DOCX files into a unified FAISS vector store for retrieval across heterogeneous unstructured data.
Model-routing layer that selects the cheapest model capable of handling each query — roughly 40% lower API token cost versus routing all traffic through the most capable model.
Asynchronous document ingestion, cutting latency where sequential loading had been the pipeline bottleneck.

projects.name: Misinformation Detection Engine
highlights: Fine-tuned a RoBERTa transformer for binary fake-news classification with custom head layers, balancing precision/recall on an imbalanced corpus.
FastAPI inference endpoint with documented request/response schemas, structured for direct integration into content moderation pipelines.

projects.name: Predictive Attrition Modeling Pipeline
highlights: XGBoost attrition classifier on the IBM HR Analytics dataset (~16% positive rate); 0.99 ROC-AUC via SMOTE oversampling, threshold calibration, and Grid Search CV — prioritizing minority-class recall.
Full pipeline from feature engineering through model export, with an interactive Streamlit interface for threshold adjustment and prediction explanation.
